resolution.summary: Based on 7 similar resolved case(s)/article(s) - closest: "My broadband drops every evening around 8. The light on" (T1, 100% match).

steps.text: Check the ONT/fibre terminal for a red LOS light and note the optical power level in the line diagnostics.
Run a 24-hour line stability test from the provisioning portal to look for evening packet loss and re-syncs.
Check for congestion on the customer's GPON port and node during 19:00-23:00.
Move the customer to a less loaded port or raise a network capacity ticket if utilisation is above 85%.
Replace the patch cable and re-seat the fibre connector if optical power is outside -8 to -27 dBm.
Call back after 48 hours to confirm the drops have stopped.
Check for a known area outage or planned maintenance on the network status dashboard.

reasons: 3 of the 5 closest cases prescribe the same fix (agreement 58%).
